\documentclass[border=4pt]{standalone}
\usepackage{pgfplots}
\pgfplotsset{compat=1.18}

\begin{document}
\begin{tikzpicture}
  \begin{axis}[
    width=7cm,
    height=5cm,
    xmin=0,
    xmax=2,
    ymin=0,
    ymax=2,
    enlargelimits=false,
    clip=false,
    grid=major,
    title={Unclipped search samples},
    xlabel={iteration},
    ylabel={score}
  ]
    \addplot[domain=-0.5:2.5,samples=7,only marks,mark=triangle*,mark size=5pt,green!50!black]
      {0.5*x+0.5};
  \end{axis}
\end{tikzpicture}
\end{document}
